title: Successive diastereoselective C(sp3)–H arylation and Suzuki coupling toward enantioenriched polyaryl unnatural amino acid motifs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21493-21527
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03486H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shefali Banga, Srinivasarao Arulananda Babu
A library of (teraryl, quateraryl, hexaryl) polyaryl unnatural amino acid motifs is generated via successive stereoselective C(sp3)–H arylation and Suzuki coupling. These molecules may be useful for future proteomimetic design (α-helix mimetics).
